blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: asymptotic — Behaviour as input size grows.
auxiliary space — Storage additional to input.

blocks.title: Identify the dominant operation
blocks.text: Single full loop grows O(n); two full nested n loops grow O(n²). Repeated halving grows O(log n).

blocks.title: Separate time and space
blocks.text: Counting two scalar variables uses O(1) auxiliary memory even if repeated n² times; copying n elements uses O(n) extra storage.

blocks.title: Interpret asymptotics
blocks.text: Big O describes a bound on growth, not an exact runtime. Constants, cache effects and data size still matter.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: Each element is visited once: time O(n).

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain the method
blocks.text: The only additional state is a scalar sum (apart from iterator control): auxiliary space O(1).
